authority: This correction is execution-authoritative wherever it adds detail or resolves ambiguity in the base plan. Every prepare receipt, execution spec, checkpoint metadata, execution receipt, validator, and test must bind both the base-plan hash and this correction hash.

forbidden_before_separate_execution_auth: any optimizer step over the immutable real 830-row dataset
games, runtime smoke, packaging, promotion, submission, or same-iteration retry
allowed_during_implementation_tests: tiny synthetic model or mocked loss optimizer steps that cannot load the real 830-row dataset
temporary-directory publication, collision, exception, and validator tests using synthetic checkpoints

single_adam_structure.stage_transition_mechanism: Change requires_grad only. Call optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) on the same optimizer before every backward pass.
single_adam_structure.successful_step_history_rule: Increment the completed-step and global-ordinal history immediately after optimizer.step returns successfully and before any post-step metric or safety evaluation. Never claim a step that did not return successfully.

gate_phase_separation.stage_1_and_each_stage_2_update: Evaluate only provenance, parameter/optimizer/value contracts and the numerical safety gates. A safety failure stops immediately.
gate_phase_separation.stage_2_updates_1_through_31: Family polarity, formerly-failing-group improvement, inherited END direction, global alignment score, and global lower median are diagnostic only and must never cause a stop or acceptance.
gate_phase_separation.stage_2_update_32: Evaluate all safety and terminal acceptance gates. This is the only normal acceptance or terminal-rejection decision point.

derived_metric_recomputation.authoritative_inputs: The immutable initial rows, zero-residual anchor distributions, and each current full float32 probability vector are authoritative. Stored scalar metrics are derived evidence only.
recompute_before_every_gate: probability-vector length, finiteness, nonnegativity, and float-domain normalization
row identity, sampled index, teacher index, END index, and legal-action-order identity
sampled probability delta from immutable initial
oriented sampled delta from the frozen normalized-advantage sign
total variation(current policy, immutable initial policy)
family memberships and every family/polarity lower empirical median
all inherited END directional quantities and global alignment summaries
derived_metric_recomputation.stored_and_recomputed_values_must_match: Every stored finite derived scalar must equal the validator recomputation under the same deterministic formula. A mismatch is a rejection and validator failure, never silently repaired.

failure_after_one_or_more_successful_ste.checkpoint_state: The current last successfully completed post-step model and optimizer state.

post_step_safety_failure.checkpoint_state: The exact failing post-step model and optimizer state whose optimizer.step already returned successfully.

exception_and_checkpoint_contract.checkpoint_identity_handoff: After the public checkpoint identity is established, any publication exception must retain and hand off the same verified inode/file identity and must not create or replace a second checkpoint.

canonical_nonfinite_encoding.path_evidence: Every receipt section containing a sentinel must also record the canonical JSON path, count, classification, dtype, and tensor or collection byte hash for all nonfinite locations.
canonical_nonfinite_encoding.checkpoint_evidence: When a checkpoint is required, preserve the real model and optimizer bytes, including nonfinite tensor bytes. Never replace checkpoint values with sentinels.
canonical_nonfinite_encoding.validation: The validator must reject an untagged NaN or Infinity, a malformed sentinel, a count/path/hash mismatch, or a sentinel in an accepted receipt.

execution_spec_contract.training_diagnostic_safety_and_terminal_: These four objects must be byte-for-byte canonical-JSON equal to the corresponding authoritative base-plan objects after applying this correction; no omitted, extra, or overridden field is allowed.
output_path_rules: canonical relative POSIX path only, with no empty, dot, or dot-dot component
resolved path must remain under the repository analysis_outputs directory
no existing path component may be a symlink, junction, or reparse point
the output directory itself must be absent at execution-boundary validation and created exactly once only after every preflight check passes
execution_spec_contract.prepare_publication: The prepare command may create the approved prepare subtree and receipt with CREATE_NEW semantics. It may not overwrite an existing path and it creates no checkpoint or optimizer.
execution_spec_contract.pre_optimizer_validation: Validate the execution-spec file hash, exact schema and key set, every bound file/hash/object/path, empty output boundary, implementation snapshot, runtime, and prepare receipt before constructing Adam.

value_identity_contract.prepare: Record every initial value output as float32 raw bytes in row order, a per-row byte hash, and one aggregate hash over the ordered byte sequence. Record the initial raw MSE using the pinned deterministic formula.
value_identity_contract.stage_1_and_all_32_stage_2_updates: For all 830 rows, require bitwise float32 equality to the initial value output, equality of every per-row hash and the aggregate hash, and exact equality of raw MSE. Recompute these checks from raw model outputs before every safety decision.
value_identity_contract.accepted_or_rejected_receipt: Record all equality counts, first mismatch when present, aggregate hashes, raw MSE, encoder/value-head parameter hashes, and proof that optimizer state for both encoders and value head is absent.

inherited_end_gate_exact.comparison_baseline: Every probability delta is current minus immutable initial-checkpoint probability.

gae_recomputation_scope.allowed: Prepare generation, prepare validation, execution-boundary validation, independent read-only audit, and tests may independently recompute GAE and normalization for verification.
gae_recomputation_scope.authorized_execution: After all preflight validation and before Adam construction, build the 830 GAE, value-target, normalized-advantage, and behavior-logprob values exactly once and reuse those same arrays for all 33 updates.
gae_recomputation_scope.fixed_hash_domain: Uppercase SHA-256 of the canonical JSON manifest-order array in the same float-domain and schema already bound by the iteration006 prepare receipt.

required_new_tests: real 830-row optimizer execution is unreachable from implementation tests and prepare
the optimizer has one unmodified four-parameter group and toggles only requires_grad
Stage2 global ordinals and per-parameter steps are exact for k=1 and k=32, and readout parameters plus moments remain byte-exact
family, END, and practical terminal failures at updates 1 through 31 never stop execution
raw probabilities are the source for recomputed delta, orientation, argmax, KL, TV, family, END, and global gates; forged stored scalars fail validation
all exception phases publish exactly the permitted artifact set and never roll back a completed failing step
tagged nonfinite diagnostics serialize with allow_nan=false and malformed or untagged values fail
execution-spec missing, extra, changed, traversal, reparse, existing-output, or unbound fields fail before optimizer construction
all 830 value outputs and raw MSE are bit-exact at every update; a one-bit forged difference fails
all inherited END comparisons use the exact initial baseline, membership, inequality, and maximum-decrease population
prepare may recompute for verification but constructs no optimizer and writes only one CREATE_NEW receipt
